explication: Dependabot-Core is a library for dependency version and security updates across many package ecosystems. Its principal workflow takes a repository’s dependency files, identifies dependencies, checks for a newer version that remains resolvable, and produces updated manifests and lockfiles; hosting tools can turn those diffs into pull requests. The graph groups shared runtime services, ecosystem-specific adapters, update orchestration, and change/PR support. Some subsystem relationships are documented in the README; source excerpts are limited, so unsampled integrations are not connected speculatively.
